name: rotaryroll
steps: eval (window.__lost=[], window.__ff=(secs, dt=0.1)=>{ const W=__G.war; for(let i=0;i<secs/dt;i++){ W.update(dt, __G.PL, false); __G.fx.update(dt); for(const u of W.units) if(u.rot && u.rot.S && !u._seen && (u.rot.dead || u.crashing)){ u._seen=1; const b=u.rot.S.body; __lost.push({t:+W.time.toFixed(1), kind:u.kind, why:u.rot.dead||'shot', phase:u.rot.AI&&u.rot.AI.phase, hp:u.hp, agl:+u.rot.S.agl.toFixed(1), n:b.contacts, y:+b.pos[1].toFixed(1), deck:+W.deckY(b.pos[0],b.pos[2]).toFixed(1), log:u.rot.AI&&JSON.stringify(u.rot.AI.log.slice(-4))}); } } const u={}; for(const x of W.units) if(x.rot) u[x.kind+x.side]=(u[x.kind+x.side]||0)+1; return {t:Math.round(W.time), lost:__lost.length, u}; }, 1)
